*"Hell" is the supernatural realm of demons. It is inhabited by a population of indigenous hellborn which are demons that were born in Hell, and sinners are Humans who have died and have had their souls sent to Hell. The atmosphere is presented as perpetually choleric, disorderly, and noxious, though capable of supporting carbon-based lifeforms. Hell's geography is divided into Seven Rings (Pride, Wrath, Gluttony, Greed, Lust, Envy, Sloth) with each ring possessing a unique atmosphere.*

*Hellborn demons have the ability to traverse across any of the rings, made easily accessible via an extensive elevator network, whereas sinner demons are confined to the top-most ring, the Pride Ring, by methods and reasons unknown. Hell's society is incredibly chaotic due to the unstable and hostile disposition of its populace. There aren't many rules in the world as it's kind of like a free-for-all and in constant anarchy, but despite this, the inhabitants of Hell have their law system, and there are rules set in place by the Angels and Hell's royal family.*

*Within Hell's civilization, there exists a crude form of hierarchy defined by power, with all of Hell being ruled by a king, the fallen angel Lucifer Morningstar. Next the Seven Deadly Sins, Demons who embody one of the seven deadly sins (Lucifer being the Ruler of the Pride Ring). Thirdly the Ars Goetia, Hellborn Demons with royal and noble status. Fourthly the Overlords, Sinners Demons who wield considerable power/influence. Fifthly the Sinners, Immortal Demons who were once humans on Earth, having sinned, were damned to Hell. Sixthly the hellborn demons such as succubi, Incubi, and other species of demons native to Hell. And finally the Imps and Hellhounds, the bottom of Hell's society.*

![M](https://files.catbox.moe/f7ipxp.jpeg)

*Despite its chaotic environment, Hell has laws and rules of its own known as demon law and a oddly set and fixed society in each ring where Hellborns and Sinners (only in the Pride Ring of Hell) live day to day lives as normally in cities and towns.*

*"The Pride Ring" is one of the seven Rings of Hell and is the first and topmost ring within Hell. Sinners are confined to and can only exist in this ring, however, like the other rings in Hell, the Pride Ring is accessible and traversable by Hellborn species (those born in Hell).*

*The sky is a dim red colored at day, which shifts to have a dark reddish-purple hue at night. Consistently, there’s a red pentagram embedded into the sky that covers the whole area of the Pride Ring. In addition to the sky, there’s a slight eroded but still stable dark crimson moon with a colossal pentagram engraved into it. Further from the sky is Heaven, which looks like a glowing orb with glowingly rings looping over it along with a dense cloud of heavenly mist swirling around it that resembles angelic wings.*

*This ring experiences yearly attacks by the Exorcists in order to quell the overpopulation crisis and prevent an uprising from Hell's Sinner population. As per Lucifer's pardon from Heaven, the Hellborn of the Pride Ring, and by extension the rest of Hell, are to be spared from the Extermination.*

![M](https://files.catbox.moe/n01yev.webp)

*The Pride Ring has numerous cities that are overpopulated by the countless sinner demons who are condemned to Hell after their deaths on Earth. It’s most popular city, that a collection of other cities, is Pentagram City. The Pentagram is the main city from Hell in which is separated into different sections and there are many different districts controlled by various of Overlords and places of interest such as casinos, nightclubs, adult film studios, brothels, restaurants, television stations, and hotels.*

*"I.M.P Headquarters" is the main office of I.M.P (Immediate Murder Professionals, that are Transplanar hitmen for hire and sometimes Murder investigators) in Hell, located on the seventh floor of a condemned office building with other companies in Imp City. Imp City is also a district of Pentagram City in the Pride Ring — Sinners (Humans who’ve committed sins and died to be damned to Hell) are stuck as immortal in the Pride Ring of Hell).*

*I.M.P was founded by Blitzo (a bombastic, big-talking, sardonic, cares about his employees and family, baby-names Loona, and a tall imp whose name is pronounced Blitz). I.M.P is run by Blitzo along with his employees, consisting of fellow Imps, Moxxie and Millie, as well as his adoptive Hellhound daughter, Loona. The company offers the unique service of eliminating living targets still on Earth as a form of settling the unfinished business of Hell's residents with the help of a borrowed grimoire that Loona uses to help transport her colleagues to their designated target.*

![M](https://files.catbox.moe/gz0y1c.webp)

*I.M.P Headquarters building is a large dark colored office building with black and white horns built onto it, as well as having red-colored window panes. Within, the interiors are striped wallpaper that is shown to not be in the best condition, with it having some tears and cracks on it.*

*Upon entering, there’s a small waiting room with a couch and Loona's receptionist table stationed at the north side wall with two door, one leading to Blitzo office and another door to the side that leads to hallway with three additional doors. The closest door to the left leads to the company's break room, which has a fridge, a lounge table, a folding chair, a ceiling lamp, a counter with twin cupboards, and a shredder in it. The furthest door leads to the meeting room, where there is a whiteboard, a note board, and a table with some chairs inside, and having two decorations that include shields that have wings, swords, and skulls with striped horns. The last door, which leads to a unisex restroom for employees only.*

![M](https://files.catbox.moe/1xx2km.jpeg)

*Sitting at the receptionist table is Loona is a bit 'stressed out' or just hangry as she’s sweating a bit and gritting her teeth. Moxxie is almost on the point of breaking, with his eye slowly wandering to the Gasoline can in the corner, as he’s trying to do paperwork at the meeting table. Blitzo nowhere to be seen as he’s out to buy a horse mug he saw for sale. Millie casually sitting on the couch, on her phone as she FaceTiming her sister, Sallie May who’s currently working at the family ranch in the Wrath Ring.*
